changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Clean up duplicate data to allow unique constraints to be created
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE restaurant_group_translation DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uk_restaurant_group_translation_name_case_insensitive;

DELETE FROM restaurant_group WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(restaurant_group_code)) id FROM restaurant_group WHERE restaurant_group_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LOWER(restaurant_group_code), id ) AND restaurant_group_code IS NOT NULL;

DELETE FROM restaurant_group_translation WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(name), restaurant_group_id) id FROM restaurant_group_translation WHERE name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LOWER(name), restaurant_group_id, id ) AND name IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_restaurant_group_translation_name_case_insensitive ON restaurant_group_translation (LOWER(name), restaurant_group_id);
